identityMasterAttempt1:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production pixel-art isometric chibi character pose masters for labcoat-tall, transparent sprites.
Reference 1 identity-pilots-reference.png: TOP LEFT is exact locked identity, TOP RIGHT illustration is character identity, BOTTOM THREE characters define finished iso game sprite style and proportions. Reference 2 hero: camera, charm, volume and upper-left light only. Draw entirely new diagonal character art; do not copy flat frontal heads, furniture or the other identities.
Character: tall slim adult woman, long straight dark black hair to waist, blunt bangs, NO ponytail, enormous bright amber/brown eyes with tiny ivory catchlights, warm tan skin, white open long laboratory coat with collar and pocket over a muted teal knee-length dress, brown flat shoes, no glasses/accessories/props/text. Identity recognisable at tiny size. Big rounded head about 40 percent standing height, visible large eyes in front-diagonal views. Narrow elegant torso, chunky readable small hands; solid clean pixel clusters, single dark outline, no dithering, no antialiasing, no realistic texture. Black hair has sparse warm-charcoal upper-left highlights. Coat ivory white and muted gray shade; teal dress shaded. Isometric 2:1 top-down camera same as accepted pilots, view from modest elevation.
Layout: EXACTLY EIGHT separate sprites in four evenly spaced columns and two rows, large transparent gaps, no labels/lines/shadows, each comparable character scale. Top row left to right IDLE facing SE(down-right, three-quarter face with both eyes), SW(down-left, both eyes), NE(up-right, back diagonal only hair NO eyes), NW(up-left, back diagonal only hair NO eyes). Bottom row same four facing directions SE SW NE NW but SEATED TYPING with bent knees, shoes below, white sleeves, clearly separated forearms and two palms reaching toward invisible keyboard: SE hands toward right and down; SW left/down; NE right/up; NW left/up. No chair or desk. Head remains upright not lowered and has same identity and scale as idle, long hair behind sleeves not hiding hands.
Pixel-art drawing should appear as native ~24 wide by42 high characters rendered at a large integer nearest-neighbor scale for editing. Entire figures including all hair and shoes fit inside their slots, same baseline per row. Transparent background. Exactly 8 isolated figures, no extra objects or writing.
